description: 【Long Range Electric Commuter Bicycle】 EBycco EB7Pro 2000W electric bike hides a 52V 23Ah large capacity battery(cells) in the frame, a total of 1104Wh, has the range power you need to reach the destination without worrying about running out of juice. The waterproof removable battery has a protection switch/lock, allowing you to remove it for charging, and no worries about theft or the rain. Switching from dual motor to single motor mode also helps you save power and go further.【 High-Performance AWD 2000W Dual Motor EBike】E·Bycco EB7Pro electric commuter bicycle is upgraded with double 1000W(100N·m Torque) brushless motors, providing you more power and excellent uphill capabilities, max speed up to 34-35 MPH, and Speed Limit and Levels are adjustable. Single-motor and dual-motor modes can be switched. Whether commuting or exploring new routes, the EB7Pro dual-motor electric bike delivers exhilarating acceleration and steady power, keeping you ahead on the road.【Full Suspension Ebike】The electric commuter bicycle are designed with dual front suspension and a rear shock absorber, keeping you in control and comfortable over rugged terrain. The frame of the e-bike is made of aluminum, equipping a Shimano 7 Speed Gears. The hydraulic brake system effectively shortens the braking time and is more sensitive than disc brakes. E·Bycco dual motor e-bike also has Headlights, Fender Set, Rear Rack, and a USB Phone Holder.【CST Fat tire Electric Bike】26"x4.0 all terrain fat tire is more durable, has a firmer grip, and gives you better control over the 2000w electric bike in different terrains, whether highway, snow field, mountain, beach, or gravel roads. You can enjoy your ride anywhere.【Advanced Color Display with Power-on Password】Equiped with the functions of Power-on Password, the full-color LCD Display shows pedal-assist Level, displays essential information, such as Speed, Level of Assistance, Battery Life, and Trip Distance . You can set a power-on password to improve the security of the adult electric bike, and turn off the password function at any time.【6 Riding Modes & Up to 35MPH】This best electric bike for commuting has 6 riding modes: Single Motor Full throttle /Single Motor Pedal Assist/Dual Motor Full throttle/Dual Motor Pedal Assist/Cruise/Walking. Pedal Assist has 5 different levels. Its fastest speed reaches 35MPH at PAS-5 Level, depending on the battery charge, road conditions, and rider weight.【Excellent Design Frame】 Heavy-duty construction integrates all the features of the best electric bike for commuting. The thickened airplane-level aluminum frame is upgraded to a more beefy chain stay to ensure your safe ride and can support heavy riders up to 330 lbs. Full Suspension for confident riding. A well-built sturdy rear rack with strong load-carrying capacity easily supports your cargo and groceries.【85% Assembled】 E·Bycco e bikes are delivered pre-assembled up to 85%, including the tools to complete the setup. Our installation videos are available on the description page to support you. We provide one year warranty for the motor, controller, battery, and charger for the E·Bycco electric bike; please keep the original package for 30 days after receiving the bike.
